drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff centered on a low E pedal tone. The drum kit features a dry, punchy snare and a double-kick pedal executing rapid sixteenth-note bursts. An overdriven bass guitar doubles the guitar riff exactly. The arrangement maintains a consistent 4/4 time signature at 140 BPM in the key of E minor. High-gain amplification creates a thick, saturated texture with minimal room reverb. The lead guitar utilizes a wah-wah pedal for rhythmic filtering during the transition. The percussion includes frequent open hi-hat accents on the off-beats.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted syncopation]
[kick drum and snare enter with heavy accents]

[Main Theme]
[full band enters, double-kick drum patterns]
[overdriven bass guitar doubling guitar riff]
[open hi-hat accents on off-beats]

[Bridge]
[wah-wah pedal effect on lead guitar]
[snare rolls and rapid double-kick bursts]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted kick drum with a long, saturated sub-tail drives the rhythm at 135 BPM in the key of C minor. A metallic, percussive synth sequence repeats a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern. High-frequency white noise bursts and resonant filter sweeps occur every four bars. A gritty, overdriven bass synth mirrors the kick rhythm with short, staccato decays. Industrial foley sounds, resembling clanging metal and steam hisses, are processed with short room reverb and rhythmic delay. The arrangement features a constant high-pass filter automation on the master bus that periodically cuts low-end frequencies before dropping back into full-range percussion.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum with sub-tail, metallic percussion hits]

[Main Section]
[syncopated sixteenth-note synth sequence enters]
[white noise bursts with rhythmic delay]
[resonant filter sweeps]

[Breakdown]
[low-pass filter on kick drum, high-frequency industrial foley sounds]
[steam hiss sound effect]

[Drop]
[full-range distorted kick and bass synth, clanging metal percussion]
